description: Find and redact personal and secret data before text goes to a model or a log: emails, phone numbers, credit cards (Luhn-checked), IBANs (checksum), US SSNs, IP addresses, API keys and tokens, JWTs, private keys, crypto addresses, dates of birth, and (names=true) people's names and home addresses. Modes: redact with consistent labels, mask, or detect only. Costs $0.004 USDC per call (x402).

country.description: Default region for phone numbers, e.g. US, GB

names.description: Also find person names / addresses with AI (texts up to 12,000 characters)
